facts.fact: 行路第三夜：她不习惯野外，跟在防御队三人身边帮倒忙；Tolan 烤兔逗趣
facts.anchor: They’d been traveling for three nights, and she was still not used to living on the road.

facts.fact: Tolan 自认恋爱、考虑求婚；Andra 替他拍板回家就问，别再拖
facts.anchor: “And I think I love her.” He rubbed the back of his neck.

facts.fact: 炎热长路：烈日如火兆般压下、水囊见底；Lucas 递衣领防晒，目标二十英里外的 Nivek 村
facts.anchor: the afternoon sun beating down on them like a flaming omen

facts.fact: Nivek 成了死村：门窗碎裂、墙上血痕、腐肉恶臭；Daegal 反复念叨这村向来热闹、不对劲
facts.anchor: “Something’s not right. This village has always been lively and welcoming.”

facts.fact: 她耳边响起惨痛低语与狂风——不是她的魔法（魔法沉睡着），是别的东西
facts.anchor: Was she causing this? The wind? The voices?

facts.fact: 屋内新鲜尸体的脚太小——是孩子；林中一声尖叫，Tolan 判定"它根本没走"
facts.anchor: the dirty feet sticking out much too small to be that of an adult

facts.fact: Daegal 被非人的力量卷上半空消失；白色残影追逐，坐骑腹部被撕开倒地
facts.anchor: An unearthly screech permeated the air, and his body was snatched around his midsection and yanked upward.

facts.fact: 怪物现身：骨白长手、染血尖爪、凹陷珠白眼、占半张脸的大嘴，以恐惧为食
facts.anchor: sunken pearly-white eyes that stared straight at them

facts.fact: 等死之际她想起 Daegal（毫无预兆）、Lucas（不该陪她来）、Tolan（希望他远离此处见到姑娘）
facts.anchor: Andra thought of Daegel. There had been no warning.

facts.fact: 跳出来挡刀的是 Tolan——被撕碎吞食的尖叫中，Lucas 一箭正中他头骨终结痛苦，Andra 泣追入夜
facts.anchor: Lucas nocked an arrow and fired true, straight into Tolan’s skull.
